name: Godrej x Godrej Gurgram Road Amp
objective: Draft press release that'll go live tomorrow- content pointers can be taken from here. Do you have a content team - can some pieces be sent to me & basis that we crack it for all 20? --- Godrej Properties Enhances Connectivity Near Godrej Aristocrat with New Access Road Linking Sector 49 and Golf Course Extension Road 24-metre-wide, approximately 500-metre road connecting Sector 49, Gurugram with Southern Peripheral Road to improve everyday accessibility for multiple residential communities Godrej Properties Ltd. (GPL), (BSE scrip id: GODREJPROP), one of India’s leading real estate developers, today announced the opening of a new 24-metre-wide access road near Godrej Aristocrat, strengthening connectivity between Sector 49 and the Southern Peripheral Road (SPR). The road was inaugurated by Shri Rao Narbir Singh, Hon'ble Minister for Industries & Commerce, Environment, Foreign Cooperation and Sainik Welfare, Government of Haryana, in the presence of representatives from Godrej Properties and other stakeholders. Developed by Godrej Properties as part of its commitment to creating holistic urban infrastructure, the government-approved road spans approximately 500 metres in length and 24 metres in width, creating an additional link between Sector 49 and the Southern Peripheral Road (SPR). The road will strengthen last-mile connectivity, improve ease of movement across the neighbourhood, and provide residents of several communities with direct access to the SPR corridor. The new route will also improve accessibility to key social infrastructure and landmarks, including DAV Public School and Sai Mandir, benefiting residents and commuters across the area. The road further enhances the location advantage of Godrej Aristocrat by enabling direct access from the prime Golf Course Extension Road. This strengthens the project's connectivity to prominent destinations across Gurugram and Delhi NCR, making it one of the best-connected developments in the micro-market. Shri Rao Narbir Singh, Minister, Government of Haryana, said, “As Gurugram continues to evolve into one of India's most important urban centres, the need for quality infrastructure that supports everyday mobility becomes increasingly important. Our government under the leadership of Hon’ble CM Shri Nayab Singh Saini has been working to improve the connectivity with a special focus on construction of 24m wide sector roads across the state. The opening of this road is a positive example of how government and private developers can collaborate and help address evolving infrastructure needs. Such initiatives, from developers such as Godrej Properties, play an important role in enhancing the urban infrastructure ecosystem and supporting Gurugram's continued growth.” Building on this broader focus on creating more connected and accessible residential communities, Ms. Geetika Trehan, CEO – North Zone, Godrej Properties, said, “At Godrej Properties, we believe in contributing meaningfully to the surrounding urban ecosystem, along with creating quality developments. The opening of this 24-metre-wide road is an important step towards enhancing accessibility for residents and strengthening the overall infrastructure network in this part of Gurugram. By improving access to key transit corridors and social infrastructure, we hope to create greater convenience and long-term value for the wider community. The road will make every day commuting easier, improve mobility within the neighbourhood, and enhance the overall living experience across the area. This initiative also reflects our commitment to creating residential communities that are connected, accessible, and equipped to support the evolving needs of residents." As Sector 49 and the surrounding areas continue to develop into a significant residential catchment in Gurugram, the new access road is expected to strengthen connectivity across the micro-market and support a more integrated urban environment.

name: Go Colors x WLDD - MICA Jam Breakdown
objective: Segment 1: The Discomfort We’ve Normalised | 0–10 mins A casual, unfiltered conversation between the comedians where they react to the best and worst MET GALA looks from 2020–2026, but instead of simply judging the fashion, they imagine what it would actually be like to live, sit and move in these outfits. As the conversation gets more animated, they start putting these observations to the test with spontaneous movement challenges. “Okay, Shreeja, you think this outfit would be fine? Can you squat right now without adjusting anything?” Segment 2: Uncomfortable Questions + Brand Film | 10–20 mins The conversation gets more playful with a rapid-fire round of “uncomfortable questions” around fashion and clothing. Questions could cover awkward movements, outfits they secretly hate wearing, things they do to make uncomfortable clothes work, and the most ridiculous fashion compromises they've made. Segment 3: Sing-Song | 20–30 mins The comedians get into a playful Bollywood sing-along where every song has to somehow be justified as being about comfort, without explicitly calling out the theme. They stretch the meaning of familiar songs, finding unexpected connections to feeling at ease, being yourself, finding your happy place or escaping discomfort. The fun comes from how seriously they defend increasingly ridiculous interpretations of the songs. For example, “Aaj Phir Jeene Ki Tamanna Hai” becomes the anthem for finally getting home and taking off an uncomfortable outfit. The more absurd the interpretation, the better. Segment 4 Introducing MICA and the thought behind it Purpose behind the event - donate clothes for someone who could use them better Date of the event - Sep 5 Come to the store, donate your clothes and get INR 500 off on your next 3 Go Colors purchases of INR 2,000 rupees and more.

Others are convinced it's a hidden campaign. Many are questioning whether the use of the name is even legal, while countless users are simply asking where the thela is located so they can see it for themselves. The story has organically travelled across multiple creator categories from Delhi community pages and street food creators to meme pages and X users turning into one of the most talked-about conversations of the weekend. A few conversations driving the buzz include: "Is this actually by KFC?" "Can anyone just use the KFC name?" "Is this copyright infringement or a marketing stunt?" "Who's behind KFC Wale?" "Street food vs global fast-food giant which side are people on?" The discussion has already generated thousands of comments, shares and reposts, with users divided over whether this is brilliant street marketing or simply Delhi doing what Delhi does best turning everything into entertainment.

Traditional wealth managers are expensive and inaccessible for most people, while DIY investing platforms leave users to navigate complex financial decisions on their own. GoReach combines AI with experienced human experts to deliver personalized, proactive wealth management. We believe everyone deserves the experience of having a trusted wealth advisor, not just the ultra-wealthy. The Opportunity We're approximately one month away from launch and are looking for a creative partner that can help us execute a memorable, category-defining launch. We don't want another fintech launch. We want GoReach to enter the market with a campaign that gets people talking, earns attention organically, and creates a strong first impression across every touchpoint. What We're Looking For We're looking for partners who can demonstrate: Strong strategic thinking Outstanding creative work Ability to execute across multiple channels Experience launching consumer products or brands High attention to craft Bias for bold ideas over safe ones Proposal Expectations We'd love to understand: Your approach to launching a brand like GoReach Initial campaign hypotheses or directions Relevant case studies Team structure Estimated timelines Budget expectations Services you would own versus collaborate on Timeline We expect to launch publicly in approximately one month, so we're looking to move quickly with the right partner. name: Tata Tele Project x Tata Comms- Tata Tele Project - Media Plan
objective: Tata Communications and TTSL Unlock SMB AI Opportunity with Unified Sovereign Infrastructure Or Tata Communications and TTSL Join Forces to Bring Unified AI Infrastructure to India’s SMB Sector - Unified AI stack combining strengths of both companies to expand the SMB addressable market - Making AI accessible with simplified deployment and scalable infrastructure designed for the pace and growing needs of India’s SMBs Mumbai, July 15, 2026 Tata Communications and Tata Teleservices (TTSL) today announced a strategic collaboration to accelerate AI adoption among India’s Small and Medium Businesses (SMB) through a unified AI infrastructure stack designed specifically for this segment. The partnership combines their complementary strengths to unlock a large, underserved market opportunity and expand the total addressable market (TAM) for both organisations. By bringing together Tata Communications’ cloud, AI and communications capabilities with TTSL’s extensive reach into the SMB sector, the companies are creating an integrated platform. This platform makes advanced AI solutions simpler, more accessible and easier to deploy for businesses without the complexity, cost or technical barriers typically associated with enterprise-grade technology. As a first offering under the collaboration, the companies have launched an AI-powered Voice Agent solution that allows businesses to deploy intelligent virtual assistants with dedicated fixed-line numbers. These AI agents can manage customer interactions, handle routine enquiries, schedule appointments and follow ups, process orders and provide personalised and always-on support at scale. For example, a pharmacy chain can offer every household a dedicated AI assistant for medicine refills and order management. Healthcare providers can automate appointment bookings and patient follow-ups. Manufacturers can provide personalised service support to thousands of customers simultaneously, significantly improving responsiveness while reducing operational overheads. The solution is powered by Commotion, Tata Communications’ conversational AI platform and hosted on Vayu AI Cloud, providing scalable and robust AI capabilities. The underlying voice infrastructure, ensuring high-quality, secure connectivity is powered by TTL. These AI agents securely access the data they require through a unified network fabric jointly developed by Tata Communications and TTL, ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient data connectivity. The collaboration reflects a broader ambition to democratise access to advanced digital infrastructure for India’s growth engine of more than 60 million SMBs. This integrated approach not only simplifies adoption but also enables flexible consumption models – from ready-to-use AI agents to full-stack infrastructure access – depending on customer needs. Commenting on the partnership, Ganesh Lakshminarayanan, MD & CEO, Tata Communications, said: “India’s AI opportunity will be realised not only through large enterprises, but by empowering millions of SMBs with access to world-class digital infrastructure and intelligence capabilities. By combining TTSL’s extensive SMB relationships with our cloud, AI and communications expertise, we are creating a differentiated platform that allows businesses to adopt AI with confidence, while ensuring data sovereignty, security and scalability. This is also a powerful example of how Tata Group companies can come together to expand access, create new value for customers and unlock future growth opportunities.” “India’s SMB sector represents one of the world’s largest untapped opportunities for AI-led transformation,” added Harjit Singh, MD of Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Limited and Tata Teleservices Limited (together TTL). "What we have built together is a sovereign AI ecosystem that businesses can consume in the way that best suits them. Customers can adopt ready-to-use AI workers, bring their own AI applications onto our infrastructure, or directly leverage underlying AI cloud and development capabilities. The objective is simple – make AI practical, accessible and scalable for every business." The partnership creates a complementary go-to-market model spanning India’s SMB ecosystem through to large enterprises and global customers. While TTSL will continue to focus on SMBs, acting as the primary channel to bring AI-led solutions to this segment, Tata Communications will maintain its focus on global enterprises and communication service providers. Together, this approach not only extends the access to AI and digital infrastructure across previously underserved customer segments, but it also expands the combined TAM by enabling deeper market penetration and unlocking new revenue streams. As AI adoption becomes a key differentiator, Tata Communications and TTSL are delivering a simplified, scalable and sovereign pathway for SMBs to participate in the digital economy by combining infrastructure, innovation, and distribution strength into a single, unified offering. The companies expect the collaboration to evolve beyond voice AI, creating a foundation for a broader portfolio of AI-powered solutions and digital services for businesses in India and, over time, global SMB markets. name: WLDD X Go Colors
objective: Go Colors, "Comfort" Campaign Influencer Marketing Brief for WLDD From: Team Wirality (for Go Colors) Live window: 8 July to 15 August 2026 Status: Draft for WLDD Campaign theme: Life Moves In Your Comfort Zone Go Colors is known for leggings but now offers one of the widest bottom-wear ranges in the country. This campaign repositions it from a leggings-first brand to India's go-to bottom-wear destination, and redefines comfort as more than a product feature. The thought: comfort is what gives us the confidence to be ourselves and move through life with ease. The brand film follows a Tier A Bollywood celebrity in a world shaped by image and expectation, where she is being pushed into an idealised version of herself. As the pressure to conform grows, she breaks free into a more vibrant, expressive world where she can simply be herself, transforming the people and spaces around her from rigid and performative to relaxed and authentic, and moving through multiple Go Colors looks along the way. Because comfort is not where life slows down. It is where life moves. The idea, in one line An unbranded, staged style "controversy" that the internet decodes on its own, resolving into the comfort message and the film reveal. The power is in the slow reveal. The audience should feel like they discovered it. Platforms, in order of importance 1. Instagram (lead platform for the teaser, the live, the reveal and the sustain phase) 2. Twitter (X) (secondary, for real-time conversation, memes and PR pickup) Timeline 1: Teaser to film (8 to 16 July 2026) Date Day Beat Influencer role 8 Jul Wed Digital fake OOH drops. A Tier A Bollywood celebrity's gown “leaks” and reads as a style misfire, and fashion pages start reacting. Female comedians post a preview of the IG Live. Seed the faux pas. Fashion pages and comedians tease. 9 Jul Thu Female comedians go live on the faux pas. The celebrity joins the live and drops a comment. Amplification Blast 1 follows. Hero moment (comedian live). Amplifiers recount the live for those who missed it. 10 Jul Fri PR and memers comment the same day. Amplification Blast 2, the “Comfort is calling” post. Amplifiers speculate about what the live really meant. 11 Jul Sat “Diss Comfort Kal Aana” goes live in stores and on social, with a graffiti activation in regional languages. Let the internet connect the dots. Amplifiers push people to connect the dots. 12 Jul Sun The celebrity promotional teaser drops on the brand page. Amplification pages push it. Teaser push. 13 Jul Mon PR drops. Rest. 14 Jul Tue Further PR and meme coverage. Meme pages sustain the conversation. 15 Jul Wed Brand film goes live across all platforms. Full film amplification. 16 Jul Thu Marketing press coverage. Rest. Timeline 2: Sustain phase (16 July to 15 August 2026) After the film, we keep influencers active through a second phase. It runs on a set of content concepts we have already developed and shared alongside this brief (Comfort Confessions, Fashion's Red Flags, Killing Discomfort in My Wardrobe, and The Comfort Stress Test). We are not asking WLDD to invent the ideas, we need the right creators to bring them to life. The types we need: • Relatable lifestyle and everyday creators, for the confession and wardrobe-led ideas that invite audience participation. • Fashion and styling voices with an opinionated, witty tone, for the red-flags idea. • Honest, authentic storytellers comfortable being candid on camera, for the wardrobe clear-out. • Tech, fitness and data-curious creators whose audiences enjoy challenges and duets, for the Comfort Stress Test. Where influencers sit, and how many These numbers are for the launch push (Timeline 1). Sustain-phase creators are the types listed under Timeline 2. Role What they do Number Fashion call-out pages Credibly notice the gown moment and set off the conversation 5 Female comedians (hero) Carry the IG Live the celebrity joins 3 (share a longer list with costs so we can shortlist) Amplifier influencers Recount the live, then speculate (“Comfort is calling”) 30 Meme pages Mainstream and sustain the conversation 100 Teaser and film push pages Push the celebrity teaser, the film and the sustain phase 100 Core always-on creators Work across multiple beats through both timelines 8 to 10 Indicative total: around 240 creators, with some overlap between the meme, push and core pools. Content guardrails All meme and creator content must be brand-safe. No crass, vulgar or offensive memes, and nothing that mocks the influencers, the meme pages or the celebrity. Usage rights (required on all content) • Organic: each post stays live on the creator handle for at least 60 days, with no early deletion. • Paid amplification and whitelisting: we can run creator handles as paid ads (Meta and Instagram dark posts) during the campaign and for 60 days after. • Brand repurposing: we can repost and lightly edit the content on Go Colors owned channels (Instagram, Twitter/X, YouTube, website) for 6 months, with credit. • Category exclusivity: no competing apparel or bottom-wear brands on participating creator feeds during the campaign window and for 15 days after. • Extension option: the option to extend paid or repurposing rights per creator at rates agreed upfront. What we need from WLDD 1. A phase-mapped plan across both timelines: which creators post what, and when. 2. Tiered creator lists for each role: handle, platform, followers, engagement rate, audience location and language, category fit, and a one line reason per creator. For the comedians, give a longer list with individual costs so we can shortlist to 3. Flag the core group who can work across multiple beats. 3. A content plan per creator and phase: formats, number of assets, and the messaging guardrails you will hold creators to. Keep all content brand-safe per the guardrails above. 4. Your projected delivery, with the assumptions behind it. 5. Timelines: when you can share lists, how long you need for content, and the approval windows you are building in. All creator lists and content are approved on the brand side, so plan for that turnaround. First lists are needed within 36 hours of briefing. 6. A disclosure approach that stays compliant while the teaser is unbranded. 7. A talent safety plan. The faux pas is staged. It must never read as real trolling of the celebrity, and must resolve in the celebrity's favour. 8. Commercials: your fee, creator fees and any boosting spend, plus payment terms and a single point of contact. How to respond Send a deck or a working sheet, with costs as a line item breakdown we can review. First lists are needed within 36 hours of briefing, since the campaign starts 8 July. To confirm with us Priority markets and languages, and the final response deadline. Budget Total influencer budget: ₹45L, all inclusive (creator fees, management fee and paid amplification).

name: Figuring out x Goldi Solar - Phase 2
objective: Background & Context : Over the years, Capt. Ishver Dholakiya has championed renewable energy not only as a business opportunity but as a means to contribute towards sustainable development and India's clean energy future. A reflection of this vision can be seen in Chikhalda, a tribal village located in Dang, Gujarat. Once a remote village with limited access to reliable energy infrastructure, Chikhalda has now emerged as a 100% solar-powered community. Powered by Goldi Solar, homes, schools, water pumps, and public spaces across the village now operate on clean and renewable energy. Beyond solarisation, Goldi Solar adopted the village and supported its broader development by facilitating electricity access for households, supporting schoolchildren with educational needs, and helping create a stronger foundation for long-term community growth. For many families, access to electricity was not merely a convenience but a necessity. Reliable power enabled children to study after sunset, improved access to essential services, and enhanced the quality of everyday life. The transformation of Chikhalda highlights a larger belief championed by Capt. Ishver Dholakiya that renewable energy is not just about producing electricity, but about empowering communities, enabling development, and creating sustainable long-term impact. The story of Chikhalda presents a powerful example of how renewable energy can create meaningful change at the grassroots level while contributing to India's larger vision for sustainable growth and energy self-reliance. Objective : To showcase the tangible impact of Capt. Ishver Dholakiya's vision for renewable energy through the transformation of Chikhalda, while strengthening his positioning as a leader driving sustainable development and community impact through clean energy. Strategic Thought : Vision becomes meaningful when it creates impact. While Capt. Ishver Dholakiya's renewable energy journey began with a belief in the potential of solar power, Chikhalda serves as a proof point of how that vision is translating into real change for communities. The campaign will use this transformation story to demonstrate how renewable energy can empower people, improve lives, and contribute towards India's sustainable future. At its core, the story reinforces the belief that renewable energy should not only power infrastructure but also create opportunities, strengthen communities, and generate lasting value for generations to come. Approach : The campaign will leverage Chikhalda as a real-world example of renewable energy-led transformation, placing people and community impact at the center of the story. Through a combination of founder-led narratives, impact storytelling, and community-focused conversations, the campaign will highlight how Capt. Ishver Dholakiya's vision has extended beyond business growth to create meaningful and lasting impact on the ground. The approach will focus on connecting leadership, purpose, and community transformation through a single compelling story. The campaign will also highlight how Goldi Solar's intervention went beyond solar installations to support education, electricity access, and long-term community development, making Chikhalda a living example of renewable energy-driven progress. Core Narrative : More than a decade ago, Capt. Ishver Dholakiya chose to invest in renewable energy with a belief that clean energy could play a transformative role in India's future. Today, Chikhalda stands as an example of that vision in action. From a remote tribal village to a 100% solar-powered community, its transformation demonstrates how access to renewable energy can improve lives, strengthen communities, and unlock new opportunities. Powered by Goldi Solar, Chikhalda reflects the potential of clean energy to drive sustainable development where it is needed most. Beyond powering homes and public infrastructure, the initiative has contributed towards improving access to education, enabling reliable electricity for families, and creating a foundation for long-term community growth. The story reinforces Capt. Ishver Dholakiya's commitment to creating impact through renewable energy and positions him as a leader contributing towards India's clean energy journey. Narrative Pillars : Vision Creating Impact : More than a decade ago, Capt. Ishver Dholakiya identified the potential of renewable energy and committed himself to building solutions that would contribute to India's future. Chikhalda demonstrates how that vision is translating into tangible impact on the ground. The village's transformation allows the conversation to move beyond business growth and focus on outcomes that directly benefit communities. It serves as a real world example of how long term vision, when backed by action, can create meaningful and measurable change. Positioning Outcome - Visionary leader creating measurable impact Long-term thinker focused on sustainable growth Renewable energy leader translating ambition into action Renewable Energy Empowering Communities : The impact of renewable energy is most meaningful when it improves people's lives. Through access to reliable solar power, homes, schools, water pumps, and public infrastructure in Chikhalda are able to function more effectively. The story highlights how access to energy can create opportunities, improve quality of life, and support community development. From enabling children to study after dark to improving access to essential services, renewable energy becomes a tool for empowerment rather than just infrastructure. Positioning Outcome - Renewable energy as an enabler of social progress Goldi Solar as a catalyst for community transformation Capt. Ishver Dholakiya as a leader focused on people-centric impact Purpose Beyond Business : Chikhalda reflects a broader approach towards renewable energy, one that looks beyond installations and business metrics to focus on long-term value creation. By adopting the village and supporting its development beyond solarisation, Goldi Solar demonstrates how businesses can contribute towards addressing real-world challenges while creating lasting social impact. The initiative reflects a commitment towards building stronger communities rather than simply delivering infrastructure. Positioning Outcome - Business with purpose Sustainable development alongside commercial growth Leadership focused on creating value beyond profit Supporting India's Clean Energy Vision - The transformation of Chikhalda aligns with India's broader renewable energy ambitions and the vision of building self-reliant communities through clean energy access. As the country continues its transition towards a more sustainable future, Chikhalda serves as an example of how local initiatives can contribute towards national progress. The story also reinforces the potential of renewable energy to support rural development while advancing India's clean energy goals. Positioning Outcome - Contributor to India's clean energy transition Champion of sustainable and inclusive growth Renewable energy leader aligned with national priorities Key Strategic Message - Chikhalda is not merely a story of solar adoption. It is a story of how vision, when combined with purpose and execution, can create meaningful impact for communities and contribute towards a more sustainable future. It stands as proof that renewable energy can do more than generate electricity it can empower communities, improve lives, support rural development, and create long term value for generations to come. Fin.

name: Prime Video x ScoopWhoop
objective: TITLE DIRECTION Use an IYKYK-style hook → “IYKYK: This Film Will Make You Go ‘WTF’… And That’s The Point” --- CORE Not a promo article — should feel like an internet discovery Chaotic, weird, unapologetic IYKYK film — mixed reactions are GOOD --- ANGLE “A strange indie film dividing the internet” Tough to sell, tough to explain No big budget — made on instinct Not trying to be for everyone --- DIRECTOR POSITIONING (me) Knew it was a risk, didn’t play safe Key lines: “We knew this would be a tough sell” “I’d rather people react than feel nothing” “What’s the strangest thing that could happen next?” “No format. No plan. We just made it.” --- TONE SETTER (IMPORTANT) Open/anchor with the spaghetti + tomato sauce audition scene Starts random → becomes meta (nepotism, industry satire) Already meme-worthy → sets the chaotic tone --- CAST QUICK HITS Ninad Kamat → raw, wild, standout Shivani Singh (Candy) → neon pink influencer, ambiguous Priya Banerjee (Pizza Ggirl) → quirky, distinct Dara Sandhu → stylish, likeable, unpredictable Aniket Sanghavi → fresh, hustler energy Nimish Shitole (Sunny) → weirdly funny --- “WHAT IS THIS FILM” (SHORT CHAOS LIST) Girl chasing a 12-inch pepperoni pizza Trippy car conversations Stoner: stone bombs + unused guns Peddler dressed like a doctor Marilyn Monroe crossdressing character Sugar daddy party boy Candy = neon pink influencer End with: “No format. No plan. We just made it.” --- INTERACTIVE IDEAS (IMPORTANT) Quick Q&A with cast: “Explain the film in one line” → all different/confusing answers Cast admits: “We still don’t fully know what the story is” “What is your character even doing?” reactions “WTF is happening in this scene?” breakdowns Poll: “Would you watch this?” Meme-style inserts using audience reactions --- TONE Meme-aware, slightly sarcastic Not polished, not PR Don’t over-explain — keep “WTF is this?” vibe --- GOAL Make people feel: “WTF is this… I need to watch it” Not: “Here’s a film, please watch it” Mandates: The brand TOV [tone of voice] needs to be followed.

objective: I’m reaching out from The Body Shop to discuss our latest campaign, Ban The Gyaan, and we’d love to see how ScoopWhoop can put its signature spin on it. To give you some context, this campaign isn't about traditional "marketing-speak" or pushing products. It’s an actionism-led initiative rooted in our heritage of rebellion and conviction. We are actively pushing back against the unsolicited advice and societal "gyaan" that often restricts individuality. The campaign film featuring Mandira Bedi, Sumedh Mudgalkar, and Diksha Singh captures three very different journeys, one shared truth: you don’t need permission to be who you are. And honestly, the question it leaves you with? “If nature has never followed anyone’s instructions, why should you?” We aren't looking for a standard brand feature or a straightforward campaign announcement. Instead, we want ScoopWhoop to construct your own version of what "Ban The Gyaan" means. We’d love to see your editorial team take the core philosophy of the campaign and translate it into a narrative that resonates with your audience’s lived experiences, perhaps something that is bold, relatable, and unapologetic. We are looking for ideas and commercial commercials for the following: · Digital Feature: A high-impact article on your website that explores the "Ban The Gyaan" concept through your unique lens. · Instagram Collaboration: Creative, original content built by your in-house team. We envision something that feels native to your handle but includes a subtle, seamless integration of The Body Shop’s campaign film.

name: Little Stories x WLDD
objective: The Context Our client is launching a branded clubhouse in Whitefield, Bengaluru. This is not a regular residential clubhouse — every amenity inside is co-partnered with a celebrity and their academy. The swimming pool is by Michael Phelps, the badminton court by Saina Nehwal, the dance academy by Tiger Shroff. On launch day, most of them will be physically present. The question is: how do you make a real estate launch feel like a cultural moment? The Campaign Idea — "Not That Kind of Club" We run a two-phase misdirection campaign. Phase 1 — The Rumour We put out content saying a club is opening in Whitefield. We don't reveal it's a clubhouse. We run negative PR — residents are outraged. "How can someone open a nightclub in a residential area?" Hoardings go up. Influencers react. The internet argues. We let it breathe. Phase 2 — The Reveal We flip the narrative. This was never a nightclub. This is a branded clubhouse — one that is redefining what it means to live well. And here's what's actually inside. Deliverable Structure Deliverable 1 — No client reveal. Pure misdirection. Build the noise. Deliverable 2 — The reveal. Client is named. The campaign reframes as: "We are redefining the clubhouse."

name: Big Boy Toyz- Auction App
objective: Big Boy Toyz Setting the Stage to Become India’s Biggest Luxury Auction House Big Boy Toyz (BBT) has taken a decisive step towards redefining India’s luxury collectibles ecosystem with the launch of the BBT Auction App. An all-in-one digital platform designed to seamlessly connect buyers and sellers of the country’s most exclusive, high-value assets. From celebrity-owned luxury cars to elite number plates, exotic watches and VIP mobile numbers, the app is engineered to bring trust, transparency and global auction-house standards to the Indian market. The platform’s arrival was marked by a landmark moment in Indian auction history: the successful sale of the VIP number plate DDC 0001 for an extraordinary ₹2.08 crore, making it one of the most expensive car number plates ever auctioned in the country. The winning bidder is Kiran Kolipakula, a high-net-worth individual from Guntur, Andhra Pradesh. This underscores a growing trend of discreet luxury consumption and investment beyond traditional metro cities. This single transaction highlighted both the pan-India reach of the BBT Auction App and the increasing appetite for collectible assets with cultural and status value. At its core, BBT Auction is built to support both buyers and sellers of high-end collectibles. Sellers gain access to a curated, verified audience, while buyers benefit from detailed documentation, authentication and end-to-end transaction support. Every listing on the platform is backed by BBT’s rigorous verification standards, including ownership proof, service history checks and comprehensive photo and video documentation. Among the most compelling listings are celebrity-owned luxury vehicles, including Dinesh Karthik’s Range Rover Sport SVR, his Mercedes-Benz EQC 400, Shilpa Shetty’s Mercedes-Maybach GLS600 and Rohit Shetty’s Mercedes-Benz CLA 200D. These vehicles offer more than performance and luxury; they carry provenance, personal history and aspirational value that resonates deeply with collectors and enthusiasts. Beyond automobiles, the platform features some of India’s most exclusive number plates, VIP mobile numbers with rare repeating patterns and high-end timepieces such as the Hublot King Gold Skeleton Chronograph. Together, these assets reflect a broader shift in how luxury is perceived; not merely as ownership, but as a form of investment. With ambitions to become India’s equivalent of Sotheby’s or Christie’s, Big Boy Toyz envisions expanding the auction ecosystem further. In the future, the platform plans to include categories such as luxury handbags, rare collectibles and even premium real estate. For now, BBT Auction stands as a trusted, aspirational destination. Where exclusivity meets credibility and where India’s luxury collectibles find a global-standard marketplace.

objective: Wint Wealth is a SEBI-registered bond investment platform dedicated to making high-yield, fixed-income opportunities accessible to retail investors. Many investors are unfamiliar with how they work, the potential benefits they offer, the ticket size on the platform is as low as 10k and how they compare to traditional investment options like FDs, stocks, and mutual funds.. Low Minimum Investment – Investors can start with as little as ₹10,000, making bond investments more accessible to retail investors. High-Yield Bonds with Strong Ratings – The platform offers bonds rated BBB to A, delivering attractive returns between 9-12%. Seamless Investing Experience – Investing is hassle-free with UPI and net banking integrations, making transactions quick and easy. Comprehensive Investor Dashboard – Investors get access to a dashboard where they can track investments, and repayment schedules, and even reinvest automatically Skin in the Game – Wint Wealth invests 2% in every bond listed on its platform, showing strong confidence in the bonds it offers. objective: Wint Wealth is a SEBI-registered bond investment platform dedicated to making high-yield, fixed-income opportunities accessible to retail investors. While bonds are a well-established investment avenue globally, they remain relatively underexplored in India. Many investors are unfamiliar with how they work, the potential benefits they offer, the ticket size on the platform is as low as 10k and how they compare to traditional investment options like FDs, stocks, and mutual funds.. Through this collaboration, we aim to create insightful and engaging content that simplifies bond investing and helps investors make informed decisions. Here’s the list of Wint Wealth’s core USPs for influencers to use and spread awarness: Wint Wealth - Making Bond Investing Accessible for Retail Investors SEBI-Registered & Transparent – A regulated platform providing retail investors access to bonds that were previously limited to institutions. Low Minimum Investment – Investors can start with as little as ₹10,000, making bond investments more accessible to retail investors. High-Yield Bonds with Strong Ratings – The platform offers bonds rated BBB to A, delivering attractive returns between 9-12%. Seamless Investing Experience – Investing is hassle-free with UPI and net banking integrations, making transactions quick and easy. Comprehensive Investor Dashboard – Investors get access to a dashboard where they can track investments, and repayment schedules, and even reinvest automatically Skin in the Game – Wint Wealth invests 2% in every bond listed on its platform, showing strong confidence in the bonds it offers. Thorough Due Diligence & Risk Assessment – Every bond issuer undergoes a rigorous evaluation process, and Wint Wealth performs quarterly audits to assess the financial health of NBFCs.

name: MAX OHH X LinkedIn
objective: Campaign Brief for KOLs (Instagram & LinkedIn) Campaign Theme: OOH - 13 is Unlucky? Not anymore. Key Message: The number 13 is usually considered unlucky, but it's lucky for Pune because Max is opening its 13th store in Baner. Vibe: Fun, relatable, high energy, and trendy. Guidelines & Pointers (Keep it Simple) 1. You must have heard 13 is unlucky… but it’s not for Pune or Baner. Flipping the superstition narrative, Max uses it as a hook to launch its 13th store, making the “unlucky number” work in their favour. 2. This is how a retail brand hijacks attention with humour + honesty. Taking an age old superstitious narrative, and flip it on its back. 3. This is OOH that talks directly to you, like a person. The tone is playful, self-aware, and a little cheeky. 4. OOH works when it becomes conversation-worthy and this does spark one. These are the kind of lines people screenshot, share, and turn into memes. 5. Max understood the assignment: talk to people in their language. For OOH to work, you need crisp, short and relatable language. 6. Turning a store launch into a cultural moment. Opening a 13th store could’ve been a basic announcement. Max turned it into a creative platform with a strong POV. 7. A brand having the confidence to tease its own audience? That’s modern marketing. 8. A great example of brand tone being a competitive advantage. This isn’t safe. It’s playful. It’s memorable. That’s exactly why it works. Sample Script 13 has always had a reputation, be it horror movies, urban legends, even building floors skip it. The ‘unlucky’ number. But Max just flipped that narrative in the best way possible. Their new store in Baner is the 13th in Pune, and instead of hiding from the number, they turned it into a creative weapon. The OOH says ‘13 is unlucky’* and the asterisk delivers the punchline. Unlucky for boring wardrobes. Unlucky for repeated outfits. Unlucky for anyone stuck in yesterday’s trends. This is great marketing because it talks directly to the audience. Not abstract. Not generic. Super contextual and super scroll-stopping — even in outdoor. That’s how you launch a store in 2025, not with a banner that says ‘Now Open,’ but with a cultural insight wrapped in humour. 13 might be unlucky everywhere else… but clearly, not at Max. include somewhere that the brand has been doing multiple campaigns... and it's interesting

name: Thode Dur Thode Paas | Zee5
objective: Hope you are doing well. As discussed, sharing below the story line of the show along with other necessary details. Budget: 50K Objective: Meme pages seeding Timeline: 25th October (trailer release) - tentative Synopsis: The Sinhas are a middle-class Mumbai family spanning three generations, each caught up in their own digital worlds. Feeling disconnected, grandfather Ashwin - a retired navy officer - announces he’s selling his property worth ₹8 crores, keeping ₹3 crores for himself and offering the remaining ₹5 crores equally to the family, but only if they live six months without any technology. Shocked yet tempted by the reward, they agree, surrendering all gadgets and reverting to a 70s-style life. What begins as a challenge soon spirals into chaos and self-discovery as they struggle without their screens, confronting real emotions, relationships, and reality itself. Starring: Mona Singh (mother, boutique owner), Pankaj Kapoor( grandfather, retired navy officer), Kunal Roy Kapoor (father, numerologist), Ayesha Kaduskar(daughter, college kid/working for funding her startup) , Satraj Singh (son, student) and Gurpreet Saini (Kunal’s brother, vlogger). Kindly help with the respective plan for the same at the earliest. Feel free to reach out in case you have any doubts.

name: Wint Wealth - Nov
objective: Here’s the list of Wint Wealth’s core USPs for influencers to use and spread awarness: Wint Wealth - Making Bond Investing Accessible for Retail Investors SEBI-Registered & Transparent – A regulated platform providing retail investors access to bonds that were previously limited to institutions. Low Minimum Investment – Investors can start with as little as ₹10,000, making bond investments more accessible to retail investors. High-Yield Bonds with Strong Ratings – The platform offers bonds rated BBB to A, delivering attractive returns between 9-12%. Seamless Investing Experience – Investing is hassle-free with UPI and net banking integrations, making transactions quick and easy. Comprehensive Investor Dashboard – Investors get access to a dashboard where they can track investments, and repayment schedules, and even reinvest automatically Skin in the Game – Wint Wealth invests 2% in every bond listed on its platform, showing strong confidence in the bonds it offers. Thorough Due Diligence & Risk Assessment – Every bond issuer undergoes a rigorous evaluation process, and Wint Wealth performs quarterly audits to assess the financial health of NBFCs.

name: The Finals - Influencers
objective: Brief 1 - Season 8 Kick-Off Season 8 of The Finals is here and it’s bigger, louder, and wilder. We want your audience to feel the hype of a fresh season while showing off just how chaotic and fun the game is. What makes this special: - Season 8 = brand new reason to squad up. - Explosions, collapsing buildings, game-show madness - it’s all back. - FREE to play, easy to jump in. - Perfect for quick, casual squad battles. Do’s - Mention Season 8 has started and tie it into your gameplay or reactions. - Show off the chaos: vault steals, building falls, funny fails. - Keep it high-energy, with hype edits or trending music. - End with a call-to-action: “The Finals Season 8 is live and it’s free to download!” Don’ts - Don’t skip the Season 8 mention as it’s the hook. - No dull gameplay or static screen recordings. - Avoid long explanations; keep it fun and fast. - No comparison with other games Caption vibes: - “Season 8 of The Finals just dropped. Buildings falling, chaos everywhere… who’s squadding with me? #FINALSAT9” - “New season, same chaos. Squad up in The Finals Season 8, it’s free. #FINALSAT9” Brief 2 – Bring the Hype We want you to show your audience just how wild and chaotic The Finals really is. Think explosions, crazy moves, “did that just happen?!” vibes. What makes the game cool: It’s FREE (no excuses 👀). You can literally blow up whole buildings mid-fight. It feels like you’re in a wild game show. You can zipline, grapple, and parkour everywhere. Pick your style: Light (speed), Medium (balanced), Heavy (tank). Do’s ✅ Keep the energy high – show the madness. Throw in hype/trending music. Add fun text like “FREE GAME” or “THIS BUILDING JUST FELL 💥”. End with: “Download and play with your squad!” Don’ts ❌ No boring clips or laggy gameplay. Don’t compare it badly to other games. Don’t mislead – the game really is free. Caption vibes: “This game is PURE CHAOS 🔥💥 I’ve never seen buildings fall like this in an FPS. Who’s downloading with me? #FINALSAT9” “Free + explosions + squad energy = FUN ✅ Who’s joining? #FINALSAT9” Brief 3 – Squad Energy This one’s all about the fun you have with friends. The fails, the screams, the chaos when the floor gives way and you all fall through 😂. What makes the game cool:[ USP] 3v3 battles made for squads. Everything breaks – walls, bridges, whole towers. Choose your vibe: fast, balanced, or tanky. Every match feels different – total madness. Do’s ✅ Keep it real – show your squad laughing, freaking out, losing it. Use memes/text like “When your squad blows up the whole building 😂🔥”. Ask your followers: “Which one would you pick – Light, Medium, or Heavy?” Don’ts ❌ Don’t drag – keep it short and fun. No toxic chat or dull clips. Caption : “Our squad didn’t just play… we DESTROYED everything 😂💣 Who’s in your trio? #FINALSAT9” “This is the most fun I’ve had in a shooter with friends 🤯🔥 Squad up now 👉 #FINALSAT9”
